chunks: Each man will have enough cares that day.

key_terms.شَأْنٌ: affair, concern, or matter of importance
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)
key_terms.يُغْنِيهِ: will suffice him / occupy him completely

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'each man will have enough cares that day'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate self-absorption of individuals on the Day of Judgment, where the weight of one's own deeds renders them indifferent to others. It serves as a profound reminder of personal accountability, emphasizing that each soul will be sufficiently occupied by its own reckoning to neglect even the most pressing concerns of its neighbor.
